techniques.title: The Slow Push-In
techniques.prompt: Slow dolly push-in toward an old man sitting alone at a kitchen table, morning light through a dusty window, steam rising from a cup of tea, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, quiet and intimate mood, cinematic color grading.
techniques.subject: an old man sitting alone at a kitchen table, steam rising from a cup of tea

techniques.title: The Reveal Pull-Back
techniques.prompt: Camera slowly pulls back from a close-up of a single red flower to reveal it growing alone in a vast cracked desert, golden hour, wide anamorphic lens, dust in the air, epic and lonely atmosphere.
techniques.subject: a single red flower growing alone in a vast cracked desert, dust in the air

techniques.title: FPV Drone Dive
techniques.prompt: FPV drone shot diving down a giant waterfall in a tropical jungle, mist and rainbows, fast fluid motion, ultra wide lens, vivid greens, thrilling and immersive.
techniques.subject: a giant waterfall in a tropical jungle, mist and rainbows, vivid greens

techniques.title: The Dolly Zoom
techniques.prompt: Dolly zoom effect on a man's face as he realizes something shocking, background stretches away while his face stays the same size, dim hallway, tense cinematic lighting, thriller mood.
techniques.subject: a man's face as he realizes something shocking in a dim hallway

techniques.title: Neon Noir
techniques.light: Neon lights reflecting on wet surfaces
techniques.prompt: Detective in a trench coat standing in a narrow alley at night, rain falling, pink and teal neon signs reflecting on wet ground, cigarette smoke, high contrast, film noir style.
techniques.subject: a detective in a trench coat standing in a narrow alley at night, rain falling, cigarette smoke

techniques.title: God Rays in the Forest
techniques.prompt: Sunlight beams cutting through tall pine trees in a misty forest at dawn, volumetric light rays, a deer slowly walking through the light, slow camera drift, magical and peaceful mood.
techniques.subject: a deer slowly walking through tall pine trees in a misty forest at dawn

techniques.title: Candlelit Scholar
techniques.prompt: Medieval scholar writing with a quill by candlelight in a stone room, flickering warm light, deep black shadows, parchment and old books, historical drama style, intimate and mysterious.
techniques.subject: a medieval scholar writing with a quill in a stone room full of parchment and old books

techniques.title: Ancient City at Dawn
techniques.prompt: Aerial establishing shot of an ancient walled city at dawn, smoke rising from chimneys, river winding through it, mountains in the background, mist in the valley, epic historical film style, slow forward drone movement.
techniques.subject: an ancient walled city at dawn, smoke rising from chimneys, a river winding through it, mountains behind

techniques.title: Earth from Orbit
techniques.prompt: Slow cinematic shot of planet Earth from orbit, sunrise creeping over the horizon, city lights fading on the night side, thin blue atmosphere glowing, ultra realistic, awe-inspiring mood.
techniques.subject: planet Earth from orbit, sunrise creeping over the horizon, city lights fading on the night side

techniques.title: Archive Film Look
techniques.prompt: Black and white archival-style footage of factory workers in the 1920s leaving work, film grain, slight flicker, scratches, slightly fast motion, authentic historical documentary look.
techniques.subject: factory workers in the 1920s leaving work, black and white archival footage with flicker and scratches

techniques.title: Lost Civilization Ruins
techniques.prompt: Slow push-in toward giant stone ruins half-buried in the jungle, carved faces covered in moss, light rays through the canopy, mist, mysterious ancient civilization atmosphere.
techniques.subject: giant stone ruins half-buried in the jungle, carved faces covered in moss

techniques.title: The Final Look Back
techniques.prompt: Medium shot of a traveler at a doorway turning to look back one last time before leaving, soft backlight, dust in the air, bittersweet expression, slow motion, emotional ending shot.
techniques.subject: a traveler at a doorway turning to look back one last time, bittersweet expression
